title: Rewinding a table tape
statement: Let $k$ be a number of work tapes, let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $x$ be an input word, and choose a tape $i$ among the $k$ work tapes. Let $ws$ be a nonempty list of nonempty fields, and write $L$ for its total field offset. Suppose a configuration $d$ starts in the left component's run phase, and for every integer $p$ with $-2 \le p < L$, tape $i$ at position $d_i-L+p$ contains the symbol prescribed by the fields tape at position $p$. After $L+7$ steps of the table-rewind machine, the configuration is exactly $d$ with state changed to the right component's done phase and tape $i$'s head moved to $d_i-L$. Before that time the machine has not reached the right component's done phase; throughout steps $t \le L+7$, the head on tape $i$ remains between $d_i-L-2$ and $d_i$, inclusive, and every other work-tape head remains at its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is a natural number and $i$ is one of the $k$ tapes
$ws$ is a list of fields and is nonempty
The initial state is the left run phase
For all integers $p$ with $-2 \le p < L$, the specified tape cell agrees with the fields tape
